newsitem.title: THAILAND: Seamico Securities unit buys new shares.
newsitem.headline: Seamico Securities unit buys new shares.

text.p: Seamico Securities Plc said on Thursday that its subsidiary Marlin Partners U.K. Holdings Ltd has subscribed to 300,000 new shares at one pound sterling par of Seamico Marlin Securities (U.K.) Ltd.
The company said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand that it was notified by Marlin Partners U.K. Holdings on Tuesday of the acquisition of the new shares.
After the capital increase, the total registered capital of Seamico Marlin Securities will be raised to 1.5 million shares from 500,000 shares, it said.
The capital increase was aimed at raising the company's working capital and expanding its business.
Seamico Marlin Securities is owned by Marlin Partners U.K. Holdings.
Seamico Securities was trading at 17.25 baht apiece, down 0.50, at 0754 GMT on Thursday.
